The rehearsal league answers two tables in `tableList` and the real league answers one, so `shapeOf` — which merges array elements into a single branch — reports the second element's fields as lost. Of this read's two mappers, `mapTeamBadges` reads only `fantasyTeamInfo`, and `mapStandings` reads header cells by `key` and never `align` or `subCaption`. Audited 28 Aug, re-checked 23 Sep 2026 when the read was renamed from `(badges)` to `(page)`.
